title: Maximum Product Subarray
description: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest product.

data.text: Given an integer array `nums`, find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) that has the largest product and return its product.

data.title: Brute Force O(n³)

data.text: Approach 2: Track Min and Max Products
Because negatives flip signs, track both the max and min product ending at each position. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Min/Max Tracking O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n³) → O(n). **Space:** O(1). A negative number can turn a small product into the biggest one, so track both the best and worst running product.

cards.title: Min/Max Tracking
cards.description: Track both best and worst running products
